obligations.required_behavior: Unknown optional profiles preserve base behavior; unsupported required profiles refuse before acceptance.
Task/idempotency reuse with different request-defining content conflicts without another execution or charge.
Exactly one terminal event; expired is emitted and timed_out accepted as a deprecated alias. Disconnect is not itself a transition.
Events have increasing sequence; byte-equivalent duplicates deduplicate; conflicting duplicates refuse; gaps request replay/status.
Observation/resume returns retained events without restarting execution; replay expiry returns resume_unavailable, not resubmission authority.
Cancellation is scoped and idempotent; already committed terminal states are not rewritten; pending stop is distinct from cancellation completion.
Query/status/observe according to acceptance; a separate execution needs an explicit caller decision and new identifiers.
Each control operation authenticates and authorizes; cross-task concealment and non-leaking responses remain distinct from a test bearer helper.
A requested cancellation, transport abort, backend acknowledgement, execution stop and released local handle are not equivalent observations.
At most one execution reservation and idempotent settlement; status/replay creates neither. No price or production credit behavior is established.
